entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: A legendary island on Dominaria, home of the original Tolarian Academy, ruined in the Obliteration of Tolaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Tolaria lies.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: The famous school of learning founded by Urza and Barrin on Tolaria.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who founded the Academy, created Karn and the metathran, and started the Bloodline Project against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Co-founder of the Academy who obliterates Tolaria with a massive spell after the Phyrexians overrun it.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A golem-probe created by Urza who uses the time machine to save Jhoira, causing the Temporal Disaster.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: An Academy member stranded alone after the Temporal Disaster and later found alive by Urza.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A student trapped in a slow-time bubble for over ten years and later rescued.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Barrin's daughter, the last individual of the Bloodline Project, who died from Phyrexian Plague and was sealed in a sarcophagus.

entities.name: Gatha
entities.description: A first-generation Bloodline Project member who left for Keld, where he was killed.

entities.name: Rayne
entities.description: A first-generation Bloodline Project member who grew disillusioned.

entities.name: Metathran
entities.description: A race created by Urza on Tolaria solely to battle the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The enemy against whom Urza gathers knowledge; their sleeper agents and invasion forces strike Tolaria.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The dark enemy against whom the Legacy was meant to be wielded.

entities.name: Tolarian Temporal Disaster
entities.description: The catastrophic failure of the time machine that destroyed the academy and shattered Tolaria's time.

entities.name: Invasion of Tolaria
entities.description: The assault by K'rrik's negators on the island, ended by the combined efforts of the Academy and its allies.

entities.name: Bloodline Project
entities.description: Urza's secret multi-generational project to produce mortal heroes to stand against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Obliteration of Tolaria
entities.description: The destruction of Tolaria by Barrin's spell after the Phyrexians swarmed it.

entities.name: Tolaria West
entities.description: A new academy island in the northern Spice Isles honoring the original Tolaria.

entities.name: Tolaria of the Depths
entities.description: A campus established underwater among the ruins of the original Tolaria by 4560 AR.

events.summary: Urza and Barrin found the Tolarian Academy on Tolaria, admitting only children.
events.quote: Urza and Barrin founded the Tolarian Academy

events.summary: Urza creates the golem-probe Karn to survive time travel in his plan to change the past.
events.quote: Urza created a golem-probe, soon after named Karn

events.summary: Karn uses the time machine to save Jhoira, whose life was taken by a Phyrexian sleeper agent.
events.quote: taken by a Phyrexian sleeper agent during a Phyrexian assault in 3307 AR

events.summary: The time machine fails catastrophically, destroying the academy and leaving Tolaria a shattered temporal landscape.
events.quote: destroying the academy and leaving Tolaria a shattered temporal landscape.

events.summary: Urza escapes with Barrin and thirteen others, Karn rescues thirty-three more, and Jhoira is stranded alone.
Urza, Barrin and Karn return with new students and find Jhoira alive and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble.
events.quote: discovered Jhoira still alive, and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble.

events.summary: The Invasion of Tolaria begins while Urza is away, and is ended by Barrin, Jhoira, Teferi and their allies.
events.quote: This invasion was ended only through the combined efforts of Barrin and his students, faculty, and artifact creatures

events.summary: Urza secretly starts the Bloodline Project to create mortal heroes to wield the Legacy against Yawgmoth.
events.quote: Urza also secretly started the Bloodline Project

events.summary: Hanna dies of Phyrexian Plague during the Phyrexian Invasion.
Barrin seals Hanna in a sarcophagus and obliterates Tolaria with a massive spell after the Phyrexians swarm it.
events.quote: he sealed Hanna in an impenetrable sarcophagus and obliterated the entire island with a massive spell

events.summary: Scholars found Tolaria West and later a campus is built underwater among the original's ruins.
events.quote: the Tolarian Academy has also established a campus deep underwater, among the fallen ruins of the original Tolaria.

relations.note: Urza made Karn as a golem-probe.
relations.quote: Urza created a golem-probe, soon after named Karn

relations.note: The metathran race was created by Urza.
relations.quote: the island was the birthplace of the metathran race, created by the planeswalker Urza
Urza and Barrin founded the Tolarian Academy
Barrin's daughter Hanna died from Phyrexian Plague.

relations.note: He obliterates the island they have overrun.
relations.quote: he sealed Hanna in an impenetrable sarcophagus and obliterated the entire island with a massive spell

relations.note: Tolaria is an island on Dominaria.
The Bloodline Project aims to wield the Legacy against Yawgmoth.
relations.quote: wield the Legacy as a weapon against Yawgmoth
